name: io.github.dassey/yab-mcp
title: YABlenderMCP
description: Local-only Blender 5.1 for AI agents: modeling, rendering, 3D-print prep. No keys, no cloud.

environmentVariables.name: YAB_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token from the YABlenderMCP add-on preferences (yab-mcp install sets one and prints it)

environmentVariables.name: YAB_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the YABlenderMCP add-on in Blender

environmentVariables.name: YAB_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to expose (default: all)
